definitions.explanation: an official book or system for recording important information such as accounts, assets, or membership

notes:
{台帳|だいちょう} refers to an official register or ledger used to record important information systematically.

WRITING:
- {台|だい} (stand, base, platform)
- ⟦{帳|ちょう}→帳：10012_chou⟧ (notebook, register, account book)

TYPES:
- ⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧{台帳|だいちょう} (customer register)
- ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧{台帳|だいちょう} (land register)
- ⟦{資産|しさん}→資産：15655_shisan⟧{台帳|だいちょう} (asset register)
- ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧{台帳|だいちょう} (inventory ledger)
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧{台帳|だいちょう} (membership register)
- ⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧{台帳|だいちょう} (employee register)
- ⟦{備品|びひん}→備品：16253_bihin⟧{台帳|だいちょう} (equipment register)

MODERN USAGE:
- Originally physical books, now often digital databases
- Still called {台帳|だいちょう} even in electronic form
- ⟦データベース→データベース：04720_deetabeesu⟧{台帳|だいちょう} (database register)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{帳簿|ちょうぼ}→帳簿：07961_choubo⟧ - more general accounting books
- {台帳|だいちょう} - official records, often government or corporate

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{帳簿|ちょうぼ}→帳簿：07961_choubo⟧ (ledger, account book)
- ⟦{登記簿|とうきぼ}→登記簿：25519_toukibo⟧ (registration book)
- ⟦{名簿|めいぼ}→名簿：11870_meibo⟧ (name list, roster)
